items.briefing:
Australian regulators have flagged that home battery systems — such as those connected to solar setups — are now subject to cybersecurity compliance requirements. If your organisation or staff manage facilities with smart energy storage, this may create new obligations worth checking with your IT or facilities team.

Separately, scam activity continues to be flagged via Scamwatch, so staff should remain cautious about unsolicited calls, texts, or emails requesting personal or financial information.

**Tip:** If you receive an unexpected message asking you to click a link or verify details, go directly to the official website instead of using any link provided.
